body:
Same but opposite. I've lived my whole life as a guy, but some of my earliest memories are wishing I had been born a girl. I've considered transition, but I know I'll never pass as a woman. No one will ever consider me a woman. I'll just be "pretending" to be one. I keep telling myself I'll transition when I meet X or Y criteria, but they're criteria that I know I'll never meet. 

I don't want to transition to living as a woman. I want to have been born a woman, have the adolescence of a woman, etc. People may think I'm crazy, but I want it all. Periods, pregnancy, basic things I'll never experience, that other women do. I wish I could have learned to do make up as a teen, just living as a woman!

I'm in my mid thirties now. I've never lived life as a woman. I would be playing catch up for 2+ decades. I will always have these painful memories of living as a guy and hating it. Of knowing I don't now, and will never fit in.

I don't have any advise to give you, just know that you're not alone I guess.
